headline: Release preparation: five local outcomes; no production promotion claimed

items.title: Local: Carry shared content into the Contact draft
items.insight: Visitors can send shared information without reconstructing a lost message. A real share-to-contact click preserves Unicode title, text and URL as editable plain text; existing topic, blank and restored-form paths remain correct.

items.title: Local: Count one page rating during its cooldown
items.insight: Visitors can give one reliable reaction without inflating the feedback used to improve the site. Rapid clicks and reopening cannot post twice; denied storage still has an in-memory guard; failed requests retry once on revisit; replay completion preserves a newer rating and other page entries.

items.title: Local: member entrance and profile continuity
items.insight: The account entrance separates free membership from investor approval. Browser checks cover profile completion before safe destination resume; live provider acceptance remains pending.

items.title: Local: separate premium investor workspace
items.insight: Investor Relations has a dedicated gateway, application and workspace. Identity creation stays separate from approval; private data in local UI captures is fixture data.

items.title: Local: trusted audience recovery
items.insight: Signed browser context preserves the intended audience and sign-in mode. Nine deployed staging recovery cases pass; positive authenticated journeys remain pending.

blockers: Supported provider signup intent, website enrollment and positive authenticated journeys remain unverified.
Final complete source/staging/hosted release, production readback and main publication remain pending.
followUps: Locally implemented: Contact drafts, feedback admission, member onboarding, premium Investor Relations and trusted recovery. Evidence: docs/RELEASE_S409.json.
Mobile215/215 and336 reviewed visual captures pass; fixtures and public cards do not prove private authentication.
This is a preliminary evidence boundary. Resume bound S409; full closeout and goal completion are not asserted.
